title: What the Arm Reaches From Here: The Ring Around the Arm, Where the Base May Stop, and How Much Room It Leaves

artifact.note: what an arm on a base can reach from where the base is: the target in the world put into the arm's frame and asked of the arm's inverse kinematics (tool pointing down); the ring the arm reaches at a height, as an inner and an outer radius from its own axis, found by stepping outward along a line; a quick test of a base pose against that ring; and the width of the ring, which is how far from the ideal place the base may stop and still reach
